selection_rule.precondition: Every one of the 12 save-pattern cells has a timed normalized stream on both required platforms, and each full-scale successor capture passes its semantic and digest checks. Missing arms produce an explicit unresolved decision.
selection_rule.idle_interval_ms: Choose the smallest candidate that produces zero false meaningful-save cuts in every timed stream. Report added settling latency separately.
selection_rule.maximum_uncheckpointed_bytes: Recovery-only checkpoints are never meaningful saves. Choose the smallest candidate whose p95 recovery-checkpoint count is at most 32 per operation and which preserves at least one intermediate recovery point in every full-scale successor install.
selection_rule.maximum_uncheckpointed_time_ms: Recovery-only checkpoints are never meaningful saves. Choose the smallest candidate whose p95 recovery-checkpoint count is at most 32 per operation and which preserves at least one intermediate recovery point in every full-scale successor install.
selection_rule.platform_disagreement: Select explicit per-platform values or leave the parameter unresolved; never average platforms.
selection_rule.aggregation: False meaningful-save cuts, recovery-preservation frequency, and time or bytes at risk are reported separately and are never combined into one score.
